purpose: Design of the abstraction layer for forge document search: defines the four wrapper SKILLs, their arguments, output contract and SKILL contract, delegating to doc-link or doc-db backends.
summary: Overview: forge delegates document search and index updates to external backends via wrapper SKILLs
Skill list: query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules, update-db-specs with fixed categories
Query skills: {task} argument and execution flow with backend order resolution
Query skills never build indexes; they delegate to update skills only with approval and a fixed backend
No grep fallback: explicit error when no backend is available
Output contract: Required documents path list built by script, common across backends
SKILL contract: inherited-type search SKILL, no context fork, allowed-tools, args limited to keywords
Update skills: --backend override, order resolution, backend-specific update paths
Desired-state semantics: .doc_structure.yaml is the source of truth for the target set
tasks: Designing or changing document search backend selection
Calling query skills from other forge skills
Reviewing the document search wrapper design
Writing tests or lint for wrapper SKILLs
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
